goal: Wave 3 build: Durable content-free timing and waterfall; Builder with draft preview and publish history; Bridge-less static widget in the opaque-origin sandbox; inference-core api_key principal; Public Agent API ingress in the Verevon gateway; Share-model ADR and conversation_snapshot taxonomy type NOTE: run every pnpm command with the env var pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false. A change to any .proto needs generated code: put the exact buf/regen step in lead_todo instead of hand-editing generated Go files, keep the change additive, and comment every new field and message (buf lint ratchet). NOTE: one model-gateway plus execution-core test build takes most of the free disk, so build only the test targets your slice names; never create a new cargo target directory, use only the given targetDir. NOTE: Wave 3 is built in wave mode: build the code and its tests, log depth findings, no live stack and no docker (the lead runs docker). Live proofs go to the depth phase. NOTE: code first (owner order 2026-11-03): write the code and the unit tests the row names, do not run them; one guard agent compiles after the batch. session-core migrations taken: 0100, 0101, 0103, 0104, 0105 (EP-4-S5), 0106 (EP-12-S14) and any newer file in the migrations folder: take your reserved round-B number if still free, else the next free number; capability-core the next free at or above 0036. slices.title: Durable content-free timing and waterfall
slices.summary: Adds new run_ledger.proto (RunTimingRecorded, RunActionTiming, RunLedgerService.GetRunTiming; add to mp-contracts build.rs), EventType RUN_TIMING_RECORDED = 150 in events.proto and RunAgentResponse.round_timing = 12 in execution.proto (behind EXECUTION_ROUND_TIMING). Gateway persists the turn_timing report (schema turn-timing-v1) and Do-run round timing (round-timing-v1) as one type-150 event after the frame, best effort, via new run_timing_persist.rs; new GET /v1/runs/:run_id/timing refuses ZDR bearers with feature run_inspection. Session-core reads events plus tool-intent rows owner-only; FE adds RunWaterfall and uses durable timing in the ledger. Also switches EXECUTION_ROUND_TIMING and SESSION_CORE_RUN_LEDGER_READ. No migration.
slices.remaining: D2-199 (open register row, P1): owner or lead must decide whether the WS15-S4 failed_attempts_ms / retry_wait_ms additions to the turn_timing wire are gated or accepted, because S5 freezes that shape into storage. D2-201 (turn_timing tests not seen passing) must also be green.

slices.title: Bridge-less static widget in the opaque-origin sandbox
slices.summary: A closed ```widget fence in a chat assistant answer renders inline in a srcdoc iframe with sandbox=allow-scripts only (never allow-same-origin), PREVIEW_CSP first, then host theme tokens (--vv-*). New pure inline-widget.ts (fence detection, 100,000-char cap, sanitised theme CSS), additive sandboxWidgetDocument in sandbox-html.ts (sandboxHtmlDocument byte-identical), InlineWidget.tsx with an InlineWidgetSurface context defaulting to inert so the Space room, people's posts and user messages keep the code block, and a third branch in MarkdownCodeBlock. Switch VITE_CHAT_INLINE_WIDGETS (literal 'true', default off; off = code block as today).

slices.title: Public Agent API ingress in the Verevon gateway
slices.summary: New BFF domain agent_api.rs mirrors the S3 spec at /api/agent/v1/*: strips caller Authorization, x-*-authorization and scoping headers, exchanges x-api-key at auth-core for model-gateway, session-core and (start route) inference-core tokens with the gateway's own service credential, caches tokens by key hash until expiry, forwards to model-gateway /v1/agent/*, maps errors to the S3 codes, per-key rate limit. The key goes only to auth-core and is never logged. Off: router not merged.
test_commands: cargo test --manifest-path "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3/apps/gateway/Cargo.toml" --all-targets agent_api

must not leak upstream secrets or forward caller scoping headers

decisions_defaults.D4: Public prefix /api/agent/v1; key exchanged per audience at auth-core with the gateway's service credential; tokens cached by hash of the key until exp - 10 s
decisions_defaults.D3: The gateway is the only exchange caller
